$comment: Mastra Studio for staff (apps/agent-studio, studio.psizone.ro). Module `agent` (an .fga module name is an identifier, so not the app slug agent-studio; the object type agent_studio carries its prefix). One object, agent_studio:psi. Studio asks Check(user:<sub>, view|operate, agent_studio:psi) through @psi/account's OpenFGA client and stores no role. Until psi's OpenFGA has a store and model for it, src/auth/authorize.ts (groupAuthorizer) evaluates the same two relations from the directory groups app-agent-studio-viewer and app-agent-studio-operator, which Authentik vouches for (userinfo), never from a request header. AGENT_STUDIO_MODE=read-only (the default) refuses operate to everyone.

description.en: Runs agents, tools and workflows when Studio is in operate mode.
